is_anopheles.evidence: Page 1: 'Multi-omics analysis identifies loci associated with pyrethroid resistance across sister species in the Anopheles gambiae species complex' (An. gambiae, An. coluzzii, An. arabiensis).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Page 7 and Table 3: Genotyped and identified Vgsc target site markers including Vgsc I1527T, V402L, L995F, L995S, N1570Y, and P1874S/L.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Page 7 (and Page 17): Screening of 95 field-collected An. arabiensis from Burkina Faso for Vgsc I1527T yielded 4 positive (heterozygotes), 85 wildtype, and 6 failed reactions. Additionally, N=9 field-caught Tengrela (F) An. coluzzii were whole-genome sequenced with variants reported.

african_field_population.evidence: Page 7 & 17: Wild-caught field mosquitoes collected in Burkina Faso (Tengrela in 2019 and 2021; Tiefora in 2021; Ouagadougou [Zogona and Karpala] in 2022).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical research paper featuring novel whole-genome sequencing, TaqMan/LNA assays, WHO tube bioassays, and functional testing.

sub_country_location.evidence: Page 17: Specific collection locations in Burkina Faso include Tiefora village (10.624116669/-4.55335), Tengrela (10.65188333/-4.82441667), and Ouagadougou sites Zogona (12.3786/-1.48752) and Karpala (12.31929/-1.50171).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Page 17: Field collections specified for distinct timeframes: Tengrela (2019 and Sept 2021), Tiefora (July-Sept 2021), and Ouagadougou (Sept and Nov 2022).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Field samples were collected directly by authors/collaborators (CNRFP/LSTM) and new sequence/genotype data generated for this study.

supplement.evidence: The main text (Page 7) provides extractable genotype counts (95 field An. arabiensis: 4 heterozygous for I1527T, 85 wildtype, 6 failed).

assessment.summary: This multi-omics study analyzed genome-wide variation across An. gambiae, An. coluzzii, and An. arabiensis populations from Burkina Faso and Côte d'Ivoire. The study reports the detection and genotype counts of Vgsc I1527T in wild-caught field An. arabiensis from Burkina Faso, alongside genotype-phenotype association testing for GSTE7 L207I using WHO tube bioassays.
